newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia gold miners say shake-up no help to output.
newsitem.headline: Russia gold miners say shake-up no help to output.

text.p: Russian gold industry officials said on Thursday that gold output would not rise significantly as a result of any liberalisation of the domestic gold market.

"The laws (on gold market liberalisation) will have a minor impact on gold production," Viktor Tarakanovsky, chairman of the Gold Prospectors' Union, told a news conference. "They will not give a big push to gold mining development."
First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said last week that Russia would free up the gold market.
